Text: {DeadSpouse} asks for backup
{DeadSpouse} is requesting a full tech team at {Location}

A messenger has been sent back with reports of a pre-Collapse Interstellar Authority research center hidden in a nearby uncolonized system. 

Eager to see the facilty, you join the tech team on the excursion.
You cannot locate the shuttle from your House’s original expedition

As you enter the research center to search for clues, you find a gruesome scene.

The life support systems are damaged beyond repair, the equipment is mostly wrecked and, to bring this horror to a grisly climax, the corpses of your expedition litter the halls. Whatever {DeadSpouse} discovered, {he(DeadSpouse)} paid for it with {his(DeadSpouse)} life. You owe it to {him(DeadSpouse)} and {his(DeadSpouse)} {link(if(isMale(SurvivingSpouse), "widower", "widow"), SurvivingSpouse)} to investigate further.
"This was the genesmithing facility for the Interestellar Authority’s Elite Division"

Your scientist launches into a lecture about the Authority's efforts to create hyper-responders to anabolic compounds: “Endogenous production... Satellite interactions... Exposure tolerance...” 

“In standard language?” you sigh.

“It creates super soldiers, my liege. Increases muscle mass, strength, speed and aggression. There may be enough material left to replicate the effect on one individual, once we've recovered these machines and spent a few months analysing them." He shrugs. "What's left of them, that is."
{D_s(SurvivingSpouse)} investigation into DC’s movements leads {him(SurvivingSpouse)} to a manufacturing facility in {NextLocation}

The workers speak of a huge, deranged man who claimed that the universe was a simulation, and the Earth had not actually been destroyed "out there". Irrational and frenzied, he kept repeating the phrase “the doctor must pay."

{Dhas(SurvivingSpouse)} had enough, and deploy{s(SurvivingSpouse)} a few agents across nearby systems. If a bulky lunatic is talking about a simulation, they’ll convince him that they know how to escape it.
{D_s(SurvivingSpouse)} investigation into DC’s movements leads {him(SurvivingSpouse)} to a manufacturing facility in {NextLocation}
{He(SurvivingSpouse)} insist{s(SurvivingSpouse)} on confronting DC. "This is something I must do alone."
{D(SurvivingSpouse)} took DC out with a suicide bomb
A hefty price for revenge

DC smiles as he turns to face {d(SurvivingSpouse)}. "I'm here to escape this simulation. What do I do?"

"You die."

You think about {DeadSpouse} one last time before you release your deadman's switch and the entire facility blows up.

An eyewitness report claims {d(SurvivingSpouse)} met with DC inside a derelict research facility. 

A powerful explosion levelled the building with both still inside. Considering what a supraphysiological specimen's capable of, you're not surprised such drastic measures were necessary. {D(SurvivingSpouse)} will be missed.
{SurvivingSpouse} killed DC with {his(SurvivingSpouse)} bare hands
"I'm here to set you free"

DC smiles as he turns to face {d(SurvivingSpouse)}. "I'm here to escape this simulation. What do I do?"

"You die." {D(SurvivingSpouse)} leap{s(SurvivingSpouse)} forward at astonishing speed. It's two hulking titans trading blows, but the thirst for revenge gives {d(SurvivingSpouse)} an edge. Finally, {heis(SurvivingSpouse)} able to grab DC by the leg and fling him through a concrete wall, stunning him.

"You took everything away from me," {he(SurvivingSpouse)} growl{s(SurvivingSpouse)}, crushing DC's windpipe.
With vengeance satisfied, you truly hope {d(SurvivingSpouse)} can rebuild {his(SurvivingSpouse)} life.

"Turn that off. I've seen enough"
